title: About SNEStorage
introduction: A home for the tools, ideas, and resources that keep Super Nintendo creation moving forward. SNEStorage brings SNES hacking and homebrew resources together in one place.

sections.title: Find what you need
sections.text: Explore tools, graphics, music, documentation, and other resources for SNES projects. Browse by game, category, type, or tags.

sections.title: Share with context
sections.text: Give your work a home with previews, dependencies, release notes, and version history. Credit the people behind each resource and help others use it.

sections.title: Create together
sections.text: Discuss resources, leave feedback, and connect with other creators. The optional Seal of Quality identifies versions reviewed by SNEStorage staff.

creator.name: anonimzwx
paragraphs: I'm a Unity developer and SNES ROM hacker. My work includes 2D and 3D games, gameplay systems, and interactive VR experiences for PC and Meta Quest.

On the SNES side, I build custom sprites, bosses, and systems for Super Mario World. My projects include Random Revolution: First Blood and Random Revolution X, alongside tools and systems such as Dynamic X and Dyxen.
SNEStorage is my project for bringing SNES resources and the people who create them together.
